protocol:
1. Aspirate a small aliquot of purple sample mixture from a microcentrifuge tube using a single-channel adjustable micropipette fitted with a disposable tip.

2. Load the purple sample mixture into a well of the gel submerged in clear running buffer in the right-side horizontal electrophoresis chamber.

3. Aspirate a second aliquot of purple sample mixture from another microcentrifuge tube using the same single-channel micropipette with a fresh disposable tip.

4. Load the second purple sample mixture into another well of the submerged gel in the horizontal electrophoresis chamber.

5. Discard the used pipette tip into the red waste container.

6. Connect the electrophoresis chamber electrode lead to the power supply terminal, matching the black lead to the black terminal and the red lead to the red terminal.

7. Start the electrophoresis run on the power supply; the display changes from “End” to active run readouts while the horizontal gel chamber remains connected by red and black leads.
